from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.DebateWithModerator(worker_llm=self.llm, moderator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, agent_prompts=[prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_DEBATE_AGENT] * 3, moderator_prompt=prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_DEBATE_MODERATOR, n_rounds=2)
        draft = await debate(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_REPAIR_FROM_DRAFT, prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_FINAL_VERIFY])
        solution = await seq(problem + "\n\nCandidate solution:\n" + draft["response"])
        worker_usage = self.llm.get_usage_delta()
        aggregator_usage = self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() if self.aggregator_llm is not self.llm else {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0}
        return solution["response"], {"worker": worker_usage, "aggregator": aggregator_usage}
